scenario.name: A_rv20
scenario.description: Truth S301A, S301 RV 20 km/s from 2030 (HARMONI-like).

S301A.element_epoch_note: Osculation epoch not stated in the paper. We use the preceding apocentre t_p - P/2 (P = 8.682 yr from a, M, R0), as GRAVITY 2024 does for S2 (2010.35) and S29 (1977). Any epoch 2017-2022.9 fits the digitized points about equally (chi2 within ~3); any epoch after the 2023.13 pericentre is rejected (RMS 3 mas, chi2 ~6000): the osculating omega jumps by the ~2 deg Schwarzschild precession across pericentre. See validation.md.
S301A.source: GRAVITY Collaboration 2026, Nature (arXiv:2607.12664), Extended Data Table 2, first value/error pair (= solution A; adopted by arXiv:2609.06936 and by Ext. Data Fig. 5)

S2.source: GRAVITY Collaboration 2024 (arXiv:2409.12261) Table B.1; elements osculating at 2010.35 (table caption)

S29.t_p_err_note: Prefactor lost in the PDF text layer ('x10^-4'); error of order 1e-4..1e-3 yr. Recover from the PDF.
S29.source: GRAVITY Collaboration 2024 Table B.1; elements osculating at 1977 (table caption)
